findings.title: Drag preview ignores feature visibility
findings.message: During a drag, only the primary body's handles are computed from drag.after, but the scene objects are rebuilt without visibility filtering (timeline marker) and without selection-based refresh. Hidden (rolled-back) objects become visible during preview, so the preview differs from the committed result.
findings.suggestion: Build the preview scene through the same visibility logic as refresh() (e.g. refactor refresh to take a document) instead of copying raw objects.

findings.title: In-place reuse of scene object slice
findings.message: Appending into m.scene.Objects[:0] reuses the backing array that the renderer may hold, mutating the object slice in place; the slice may also alias earlier data. Also, transform errors during move leave the old preview but silently continue.
findings.suggestion: Assign a fresh slice: m.scene.Objects = slices.Clone(s.Objects).

findings.title: Numeric delta with empty selection creates no-op undo entry
findings.message: The numeric commit uses m.handleMode as of commit time and the numeric path with an active drag calls apply, which errors; fine, but with no selection transform silently succeeds with no changes and records an empty undo action.
findings.suggestion: Reject when m.selectedIndex() < 0 or when the delta is zero before applying.
findings.evidence: s, e := m.transform(m.state, i, v/20, m.handleMode)
